features: f1.6 aperture for clear color night vision, with invisible infrared LEDs
up to 256GB microSD local storage plus encrypted cloud storage
SwitchBot ecosystem: auto-rotate/record when linked to Motion Sensor, Lock and Contact Sensor
Alexa voice control including privacy mode (lens retracts)

frigate.notes: No RTSP/ONVIF documented for the indoor Pan/Tilt Cam Plus 3K; it is managed through the SwitchBot app and is not natively Frigate-compatible.

home_assistant.notes: No official Home Assistant integration; access is via the SwitchBot app / Alexa. Some users bridge through the SwitchBot cloud API for automations, not live video.

blue_iris.notes: Not supported - no RTSP/ONVIF stream exposed; SwitchBot app only.
